span.p:
Gates fall, not rise — on purpose
a non-stepping fighter scores 1.000 at StandStill
but only 0.345 at Shuffle, so a rising gate
would ask more while paying less.
From Shuffle on, standing cannot pass.

Headless option

trainer is the bottleneck at ~390% CPU,
not PhysX — a 3rd env buys 6.6%
